title: Count and sort
summary: wc counts things such as lines. sort writes lines in order to its output. Piping connects one command's output to another.
introduction: wc counts things such as lines. sort writes lines in order to its output. Piping connects one command's output to another. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Sorting output does not rewrite the original file unless you explicitly write a result.
For more detail later, use this [Linux further reading](https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/coreutils.html).
